female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

female-community-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention benefits to their family or community fund faster.
female-community-benefit-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight how the loan will benefit their family or the wider community tend to accelerate funding speed.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

loan-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayments predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
loan-history-faster.body: Pitches from both men and women that explicitly reference a successful track record of repaying previous loans tend to accelerate funding speed.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

family-mention-interaction.title: Mentioning family obligations and benefits has opposite effects on funding speed by gender.
family-mention-interaction.body: Pitches from women that highlight family or community benefits fund faster, while pitches from men that mention family obligations or school fees fund more slowly.

female-specific-demographics-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide specific details about family members or spouse employment fund faster.
female-specific-demographics-faster.body: Pitches from women that include specific demographic details, such as the number of children or the specific employment of a spouse, accelerate funding speed.

female-loan-amount-mention-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state the loan amount within the pitch text fund more slowly.
female-loan-amount-mention-slower.body: Pitches from women that specify the loan amount, especially in local currency, are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-generic-family-future-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention securing or providing for the family's future may fund more slowly.

female-widow-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as widows may fund faster.

female-sustainability-tech-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize environmental sustainability and specific technology fund faster than those mentioning general supplies.

female-environmental-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific environmental challenges like weather patterns may fund faster.

female-refugee-status-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention living in a refugee camp may fund faster.

female-formal-adjectives-slower.body: Female borrowers who use formal or descriptive adjectives to characterize themselves may fund more slowly.

male-pitch-brevity-faster.body: Male borrowers who write shorter pitches may fund faster than those who write longer ones.

female-lending-partner-mention-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific name of their lending partner may fund more slowly.

female-self-reliance-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize self-reliance or single status may fund faster.

female-social-repayment-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide details about specific social repayment programs may fund more slowly.

female-volunteering-repayment-slower.title: Female borrowers who describe social interest repayment through volunteering may fund more slowly.
female-volunteering-repayment-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include direct thank you notes to lenders may fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

female-demographic-detail-slower.title: Pitches from women that specify exact demographic figures, such as the number of children, relationship status, or husband's occupation, tend to decelerate funding speed.
female-demographic-detail-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific age and number of children correlate with faster funding for women.

female-higher-loan-amount-faster.title: Female borrowers who request higher loan amounts may fund faster than those requesting smaller amounts.
female-higher-loan-amount-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation.

children-benefit-faster.title: Mentioning benefits for children predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
children-benefit-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning school fees (a benefit for children) decelerates funding for male borrowers.

female-family-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their general family structure fund faster.
female-family-status-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by evidence that general family terms correlate with slower funding while specific details accelerate it.

female-hard-work-language-slower.title: Female borrowers who use phrases emphasizing hard work, such as 'working tirelessly', may fund more slowly.
